01 Technical specifications:- EA 200 Retro-Reflective Safety Caution Board: Supply of 2 ft × 3 ft retro-refl ective safety caution boards made of rigid weather-resistant materia l, with high-intensity retro-reflective sheeting, UV-resistant printing a nd protective lamination, complete with fixing provisions, suitable fo r use in coal mine premises, as per approved design/message of the User Department. Size: 2 ft × 3 ft (approx. 600 × 900 mm) Base Material: 3 mm thick Aluminum Composite Panel (ACP) / equiv alent rigid, weather-resistant board. Reflective Sheeting: High-intensity retro-reflective sheeting, suitable for outdoor/industrial use, with minimum 7-year outdoor durability. Printing: High-quality UV-resistant digital printing with clear, sharp a nd legible safety message/symbols. Lamination: Transparent UV-resistant protective overlay/lamination to protect the printed surface from dust, moisture, abrasion and fadi ng. Lettering & Symbols: Safety message and internationally recognizab le safety symbols, as approved by the User Department; lettering sh all be clearly visible from an appropriate distance. Corners/Edges: Smoothly finished, without sharp edges, burrs or pro jections. Mounting: Provision of suitable holes/grommets for fixing with GI wir e, clamps, bolts or other suitable arrangement. Weather Resistance: Suitable for exposure to rain, moisture, dust, s unlight and temperature variations encountered in mine premises. Reflectivity: The reflective surface shall provide adequate visibility u nder illumination from vehicle headlights/underground lighting and s hall retain reflectivity during the intended service life. Quality: The board shall be free from bubbles, wrinkles, peeling, col or variation and other manufacturing defects.
